u0: Initial safe state and accepting baseline: the agent neither holds the door-matching key nor has the blocking ball been moved from the door cell. The active subtask is to avoid the forbidden combination while optionally earning the one-time +1 by establishing exactly one condition: take the matching key while the ball still blocks the door, or move the ball away while not holding the matching key. Do not make both conditions true; simultaneous has_door_key and blocker_moved fails to u2.
u1: Safe partial-progress and accepting state: exactly one allowed condition was achieved first—either the matching key was taken while the ball remained in front of the door, or the ball was moved away while the matching key was not held—and the +1 milestone has already been earned without any forbidden overlap. The active subtask is now to keep the pair mutually exclusive: if the matching key is held, leave the ball in front of the door; if the ball has been moved, do not hold the matching key. Losing the key while the door is closed (key_lost) or restoring the ball does not reset the RM, and u1 can persist with neither condition currently true; there is no further progress bonus, only the risk of entering u2 if both conditions later hold together.
u2: Absorbing terminal failure: the RM has entered u2 because the agent held the door-matching key while the blocking ball had also been moved away from the door cell, making has_door_key and blocker_moved true together. The -1 penalty has already been incurred; later dropping the key, restoring the ball, or any other action cannot recover u1 or u0. This is a lost state, not an accepting final state.
